# CAPTURE ONLY. Nothing extracted per R 1638.
# 5s2.5p ground — one electron outside a closed 5s2, all DOUBLETS, one
# limit, entirely LS. The n=5 shell member of the one-outside family,
# ** In I AND Tl I ARE THE SAME STRUCTURE ONE PERIOD APART — 5s2.5p and
#    6s2.6p — AND THEY DIFFER SHARPLY IN ONE RESPECT: **
#      Tl I  f channel   UNRESOLVED from its first member (n=5)
#      In I  f channel   RESOLVED at n=4,7,8,9,10,11,12
#                        unresolved only at n=5 and n=6
#    ** The resolution does NOT degrade monotonically with n here: 5f
#       and 6f are unresolved while 7f through 12f are resolved. That
#       is not a limit of the method; it is a fact about which
#       measurements exist. R 1578's witness axis again. **
#    In I's d channel is resolved to n=30 where Tl I's collapsed at 12.
# ** AND A DEGENERACY PATTERN: several f pairs carry the SAME value for
#    both J — 4f both at 39707.59, 7f both at 44406.31, 8f both at
#    44938.81, 12f both at 45902.92. Four rows are two measurements
#    written twice, as in Ba I's g series but without any flag. **
